schedule_intent: Up to four distinct fresh, high-quality original Pins daily at globally staggered times (03:30, 09:30, 15:30, 21:30 Europe/Istanbul), not quota filling. The fifth only if validated performance and original content justify it. Never duplicate content or flood one board/site.

image_spec.brand_colors: dark violet, black, purple glow; accessible light typography
rules: Each Pin uses a unique original image; no unrelated stock photography
One clear useful tip per Pin
No fake stats, reviews, before/after outcomes or platform endorsement
Destination is the exact relevant free tool, not a generic landing page
Verify all destination pages and image accessibility before publishing

pins.title: Social Media Photo Resizer: One Photo, Multiple Formats
pins.description: The same photo won't fit every layout. Start with a sharp original, choose a format, preview the crop, then download the size you need. This free browser tool supports Instagram posts, Stories, YouTube thumbnails and more. Your photo stays on your device.
pins.image_brief: A bold vertical before-and-after layout showing the same original portrait as a feed post and Story preview. Labels 'Before' and 'Sized for Instagram', no fake results.

pins.title: Instagram No Crop: Keep the Whole Photo
pins.description: Don't cut people out of the frame just to fit an Instagram post. Add a subtle blurred background and keep the entire image visible. Try this free no-crop photo tool.
pins.image_brief: Premium light editorial Pinterest poster, not generic dark-purple template. Illustrate the SAME imaginary cafe portrait subject in a true composition comparison: left awkward tight crop, right full portrait fitted with softly blurred background. Headline 5 words, small Socialora footer, readable at phone width; label example, do not claim a real customer result.

pins.title: Reels & TikTok Safe Zones for Text
pins.description: Your subtitles might be hiding under on-screen buttons. Preview where captions and key text belong before you publish. Use the free Reels and TikTok safe-zone guide.
pins.image_brief: Simple vertical phone mockup with distinct safe central text area and lightly shaded UI-edge zones; label diagram as illustrative, not pixel-exact.

pins.title: How to Turn a Video Frame Into a Thumbnail
pins.description: A useful thumbnail can start with a frame you already filmed. Pick a clear moment, capture it from your own video, then export a cover image using this free browser tool.
pins.image_brief: Video filmstrip with one frame selected and displayed as a thumbnail card, simple 3-step visual.

pins.title: Free Instagram Account Scorecard & Growth Plan
pins.description: Not sure what to improve next on Instagram? Enter your profile numbers to get an indicative scorecard and practical ideas to test. This is an independent tool, not official Instagram data.
pins.image_brief: Illustrative scorecard showing neutral sample values, explicitly marked 'Example only'—never imply direct access to the user's analytics.

pins.title: Instagram Grid Maker: Split One Photo Into Tiles
pins.description: Planning a multi-post Instagram grid? Divide your own image into tiles and download them in posting order. No sign-up required.
pins.image_brief: A single photo visually divided into a 3x3 grid with arrows showing tile sequence; use generic illustration.

pins.title: 3 Checks Before Publishing Your Next Reel
pins.description: Check your opening visual, make captions easy to read and keep important text away from app controls. Use this free overlay guide to inspect your layout.
pins.image_brief: Three illustrated checkpoints: opening frame, readable captions, safe text placement. No fabricated metrics.

pins.title: Instagram Bio Ideas: A Simple 3-Line Formula
pins.description: Struggling to explain what you do? Try: who you help, what you share, and one clear next step. Use these free bio ideas as a starting point, then make the wording your own.
pins.image_brief: A three-line real-world example, with each line highlighted: who, value, next step. Avoid fake social profile screenshots.

pins.title: TikTok Bio Ideas That Explain Your Niche Fast
pins.description: A TikTok bio should tell people what they'll get before they scroll away. Try one specific topic plus a reason to follow. Get starter ideas and edit them to sound like you.
pins.image_brief: A clean profile header mockup with a before/after rewriting example. No follower count.

pins.title: Instagram Caption Formula: Hook, Context, Next Step
pins.description: You don't need a long caption to say something useful. Start with one clear point, add a practical detail, then invite a specific next step. Generate a starting draft and personalize it.
pins.image_brief: A typography-led 3-section stack: hook, value, action; show one short original caption example.

pins.title: Instagram Reel Ideas When You Have Nothing to Post
pins.description: Start with one real question your audience asks. Turn it into a quick demo, a mistake to avoid, or a before-and-after explanation. Find prompts you can adapt to your niche.
pins.image_brief: A creator desk visual with three distinct mini storyboards showing demo, mistake, tip; no generic random icons.

pins.title: TikTok Caption Ideas That Add Context
pins.description: Your video already has the visual. Use the caption to add one useful detail, clarify the promise, or tell viewers what to try next. Build a draft in seconds, then make it yours.
pins.image_brief: A bold TikTok-style thumbnail paired with two contrasting caption treatments, highlighting the one with actual useful detail.

pins.title: Instagram Hashtag Ideas: Start With Your Topic
pins.description: Hashtags should describe what a post is about, not promise instant reach. Begin with the niche, format and subject. Explore relevant hashtag ideas, then remove anything that doesn't fit.
pins.image_brief: Two organized keyword clusters: relevant niche tags versus generic noise; no invented performance graph.

pins.title: Instagram Username Ideas That Are Easy to Remember
pins.description: A good username is easy to spell, say aloud and recognize. Try a clear word combination before adding random numbers. Brainstorm options with this free tool and check availability yourself.
pins.cover_hook: Easy to Say. Easy to Find.
pins.image_brief: A branded name-card grid with 3 original illustrative handles, marked as examples not availability claims.

pins.title: Facebook Post Captions Without the Sales Pitch
pins.description: For a useful Facebook post, lead with a tip rather than an offer. Give the reader one actionable idea and add a natural next step if it helps. Use these free caption ideas as a draft.
pins.image_brief: Minimal editorial post mockup with a one-paragraph useful tip; emphasize readability.

pins.title: X Bio Ideas: Say What You Do in One Line
pins.description: If a new visitor can't tell what you do from your bio, simplify it. Name the topic, who you help, and what they'll see. Use free suggestions as a starting point.
pins.image_brief: One strong short bio highlighted on a profile-card layout, compared with an overly vague line.

pins.title: Discord About Me Ideas That Sound Like You
pins.description: A personal Discord bio can be simple: what you're into, what you're creating, or what you love discussing. Explore short free ideas and edit the tone to match you.
pins.image_brief: Three playful but tasteful identity cards on a dark violet background, each with a different interest, no platform endorsement.

pins.title: YouTube Channel Name Ideas: 3 Things to Check
pins.description: Before choosing a channel name, check whether it's easy to say, recognizable and suitable for future content. Generate options, then verify availability yourself.
pins.image_brief: A wordmark study showing three illustrative channel name concepts, marked not availability-checked.

pins.title: YouTube Tags: Describe the Actual Video
pins.description: Tags work best as accurate labels, not a magic ranking trick. Start with the main subject and a few specific related terms. Generate ideas, then keep only the relevant ones.
pins.image_brief: A video outline leading to a small set of precise tags and crossing out unrelated tags; no SEO ranking claims.

pins.title: How to Save a YouTube Thumbnail for Reference
pins.description: Studying your own video thumbnails? Get the image quickly, then compare the subject, contrast and title readability. Only reuse images you're allowed to use.
pins.image_brief: A desktop thumbnail and mobile thumbnail shown side-by-side, with same illustrative image.

pins.title: YouTube Thumbnail Tip: Choose the Right Frame
pins.description: Pick a video frame with a clear subject and room for text. Export it as an image, then check whether it still reads at phone size. Try this free frame picker.
pins.image_brief: Filmstrip with selected original illustrative frame and enlarged thumbnail, plus tiny mobile preview.

pins.title: Instagram Engagement Rate: What Does It Tell You?
pins.description: Likes alone don't show the full picture. Compare relevant interactions against the chosen audience size, and use the result as one signal—not proof of overall success. Try the free calculator.
pins.image_brief: A clean, labeled illustrative equation layout with no unsupported industry benchmark.

pins.title: TikTok Engagement Rate: Measure Consistently
pins.description: Comparing videos? Use the same engagement definition and timeframe every time. A simple calculator helps you compare your own posts without relying on vague impressions.
pins.image_brief: Two original short-form video cards with clearly labeled illustrative counts and same calculation basis.

pins.title: YouTube Engagement Rate Explained Simply
pins.description: View counts and engagement tell different stories. Calculate a consistent engagement rate for your own videos, then compare similar formats and topics rather than unrelated channels.
pins.image_brief: A visual guide showing views, likes and comments as separate illustrative measures; no fake growth curve.

pins.title: Follower Goals: Turn a Big Number Into Weekly Steps
pins.description: A follower target is easier to plan when you break it into small increments. Use the calculator for a scenario, then adjust based on actual progress. It's a planning tool, not a growth promise.
pins.image_brief: A weekly planning calendar with illustrative milestones marked as examples, not a forecast.

pins.title: Instagram Sponsorship Rate: Why Estimates Vary
pins.description: A creator partnership rate isn't determined by follower count alone. Engagement, content scope, usage rights and audience fit matter. Treat calculator outputs as starting estimates, not promises.
pins.image_brief: A notepad with four scope factors and a small label 'Estimate only', no invented dollar claims.

pins.title: X Engagement Rate: Compare Posts With Context
pins.description: A big impression count doesn't automatically mean a post helped your audience. Track the same types of interactions across similar posts, then test what your readers actually value.
pins.image_brief: A calm two-column metric explainer with neutral placeholders and no claimed benchmark.

pins.title: WhatsApp Click-to-Chat Link: A Simple Setup
pins.description: Want people to start a conversation without saving a contact first? Create a click-to-chat link with an optional prefilled message. Remember: the number in the link is visible to anyone with access.
pins.image_brief: A phone chat mockup and a link card with clearly fictional placeholder number; no realistic personal info.

pins.title: Symbols for Bios: Make Them Easier to Read
pins.description: A small symbol can separate sections in a bio or highlight one key detail. Choose a simple character that displays well on mobile, and avoid cluttering every line.
pins.image_brief: A before/after short bio with subtle symbols and improved hierarchy, not decorative symbols everywhere.

pins.title: Instagram Grid Layout: Check Tile Order First
pins.description: If you're splitting one image into a 3×3 grid, post order matters. Preview the full layout, export each tile and keep the posting sequence handy before you begin.
pins.image_brief: A 3×3 illustrated tile board with small numbers showing export/posting order distinctly.

pins.title: Reels Captions Hidden by Buttons? Fix This
pins.description: Keep the important words away from the edges where social-app controls may cover them. A safe-zone overlay makes this easier to preview before you export your video.
pins.image_brief: An illustrated vertical phone composition showing blocked bottom caption versus centered readable caption; say 'Illustrative placement'.

pins.title: Three Things Your Reel Opening Should Show
pins.description: Make your first frame easy to understand: a clear subject, readable text and an obvious point. Try a safe-zone overlay so important details stay visible.
pins.image_brief: Three small vertical storyboard panels marked subject, contrast, safe placement—not false platform UI precision.

pins.title: Fit a Portrait Without Cutting Off the Subject
pins.description: A wide photo and a vertical post don't always agree. Instead of chopping off the important part, use a blurred background and keep the full composition inside the post.
pins.image_brief: An original scenic photo framing exercise with sharp centered full image and blurred edge treatment.

audience: Worldwide English-speaking creators, independent professionals and small teams; no single-country focus

design_standard.accessibility: Readable at phone width; strong typography, 4-7 word cover hook maximum, contrast checked
design_standard.composition: 1 bold useful visual demonstration + small Socialora brand signature; no giant logo or large generic marketing button
design_standard.variety: Rotate editorial typography, illustration, useful comparison, original mockup, 3-step diagram, calendar, data explainer, device preview. Use distinctive palette and layout for each topic; do not output identical purple template pins.
design_standard.creative_tests: Evaluate human clarity in 2 seconds: question, actual visual answer, genuine reason to click. If graphic or copy fails, skip rather than publish filler.
design_standard.language: Natural human English, informative rather than promotional; no guaranteed results, invented followers/comments, vague inspiration, heavy hashtags or keyword stuffing
design_standard.truth: Do not imply example UI, simulated numbers, tool capabilities or results are real; do not claim platform endorsement.
design_standard.link: Link directly to relevant existing free-tool page and preserve unique UTM; check website link resolves.
design_standard.posting: Before each Pin, verify previous 24h topic/board and actual Pinterest IDs. Avoid duplicate URLs in same day when possible. New account: prioritize fresh ideas over sheer volume.
